rows.label: tlk70000009_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey there, traveler! Could
I ask you a question?

rows.label: tlk70000009_01_msg0002
rows.name:
At what age should an older brother
normally stop making lunch for his
younger brother?

rows.label: tlk70000009_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Sorry for the strange question. I know
someone whose older brother makes
his younger brother lunch...

rows.label: tlk70000009_01_msg0004
rows.name:
And the younger brother isn't a child.
He's a proper adult with a real job.

rows.label: tlk70000009_01_msg0005
rows.name:
He's skilled enough to guard the gate
and cooks for himself! Yet every day,
his older brother still...

rows.label: tlk70000009_01_msg0006
rows.name:
...No, an acquaintance's younger
brother. His older brother makes lunch
daily, waking early and losing sleep.

rows.label: tlk70000009_01_msg0007
rows.name:
With his skill, he could've
risen long ago... Why won't
he just... sigh...
